accessibility.description: World Empire has an optional spoken accessibility mode for its strategy interface. On mobile, the publisher instructs players to turn off VoiceOver or TalkBack and tap three times with three fingers after launch. Players report that activating the mode and navigating some controls can be awkward; sighted help may be needed for initial setup. These store links identify World Empire itself, not every spinoff.
